# SubbieBill

> SubbieBill is a web app for ABN subcontractors in Australia (tradies and labour-hire subbies paid by the hour). You enter your start and finish times for each day and it creates a professional PDF invoice with your ABN, BSB and account number, the hours, the rate and the total in AUD, including GST (10%) when you are registered for GST.

Website: https://subbiebill.com/
Works in any browser, on phone or computer. Nothing to install. Interface in English, French and Spanish; invoices are always in English.

## What it does

- Turns daily start and finish times into hours, including unpaid breaks, overtime rates and public holiday rates
- Weekly, fortnightly or monthly invoices
- "Tax invoice" with GST shown separately when the user is registered for GST, plain "Invoice" with "No GST has been charged" when not
- Expense lines (fuel, materials, tolls) on the invoice
- Unique invoice numbers, due dates, client ABN
- Saved clients, sites and drafts
- Premium: history of every invoice with yearly totals, re-download any invoice, email invoices to the client, paid / overdue tracking

## Pricing (AUD)

- Free: 3 finished invoices, no card needed
- Premium: $4.99 a month or $39 a year, cancel anytime (payments by Stripe)

## What it is not

SubbieBill is not accounting software: no bank reconciliation, BAS lodgement or payroll. It is not tax advice.
